articles.summary: Palitronica today announced the appointment of a new chief executive officer, along with a bench of experienced leaders, aligned across all functions of the organization. These changes follow milestone growth as the company positions for the next phase of market expansion and technical innovation.
articles.title: Palitronica Deepens Executive Bench with Proven Growth Strategy Veterans and Industry-recognized Trailblazers

articles.summary: Palitronica Inc., the Canadian innovator in physics-based hardware/firmware cybersecurity and quality assurance for safety-critical manufacturing and defense infrastructure, today announced the successful closing of its Series A financing round led by the Business Development Bank of Canada (BDC)’s Industrial Innovation Venture Fund, with participation from Three Kings Capital, Frostbite, and Unpopular Ventures.
articles.title: Palitronica Closes Series A Funding Led by BDC, with Three Kings Capital, Frostbite, and Unpopular Funds
